description: Commit marker <device>.head.json written after the journal PUT. Build: lastSeq is the largest seq, journalBytes the UTF-8 length and journalSha256 the lowercase SHA-256 hex of the exact body. Parse: version 1, deviceId equal to the file name, non-negative integer counters, journalBytes <= 100 MiB, 64 hex digit hash, string updatedAt, body <= 64 KiB.
